text:
commit 05e247253888b7f3c1cb06af64bfd2cc4b51e3a2
Author:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Wed Mar 11 17:56:40 2026 -0400
Commit:     Stephen King <sking@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Wed Mar 11 17:56:40 2026 -0400

    Bug 2001494 Enable A11y Tests For Thunderbird CI r=arschmitz,coreycb
    
    
    Adds extra options for a11y variant to specify files we want to run a11y tests on
    
    While this is initially blank, keeping the extra config for now makes it easier to change
    flags specific to the a11y tests should it be needed in the future.  If these failures
    get sorted and we stabalize running agains the full suite, the a11y specific config can be
    removed. (the actual options to run with a11y tests enable are inherited from the variant)
    
    ***
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D276914

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
index 9f27da7cf99..052ea996eb8 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/test/tests.yml
@@ -125,7 +125,11 @@ mochitest-thunderbird:
     description: "Mochitest browser-chrome-thunderbird run"
     suite:
         category: mochitest
-        name: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird
+        name:
+            by-variant:
+                a11y-checks: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird-a11y
+                default: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird
+    try-name: mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird
     target:
         by-test-platform:
             windows11-64.*:
@@ -149,6 +153,7 @@ mochitest-thunderbird:
                     default: 3600
     variants:
         - msix
+        - a11y-checks
     run-on-projects:
         by-variant:
             msix:
diff --git a/testing/mozharness/configs/unittests/thunderbird_extra.py b/testing/mozharness/configs/unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
index 5a7d933de0d..5e919501dcc 100644
--- a/testing/mozharness/configs/unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
+++ b/testing/mozharness/configs/unittests/thunderbird_extra.py
@@ -25,5 +25,12 @@ config = {
             "--subsuite=thunderbird",
             "--leak-threshold=51200",  # 50kB
         ],
+        "mochitest-browser-chrome-thunderbird-a11y": [
+            "--flavor=browser",
+            "--subsuite=thunderbird",
+            "--leak-threshold=51200",  # 50kB
+            # List of Directories, files to be included in a11y tests here
+            # With no files or directories listed, tests will be run against full suite
+        ],
     },
 }
title: Bug 2001494 Enable A11y Tests For Thunderbird CI r=arschmitz,coreycb
